## __OVERVIEW__
Defense Frontline has come online as of <t:1790046000>.
Defense Frontline is a battle event where you challenge a daily rotation of powerful enemies.
Form an effective squad for each Kaiju and complete quests to earn rewards!

## __ELIGIBILITY__
Reach Spec-Ops Rank 2 or higher.
*Reach Spec-Ops Rank 4 to challenge VERY HARD.*

## __EVENT DESCRIPTION__
- Defense Frontline is an event where you challenge daily rotating Kaiju.
- Defense Frontline runs for 10 days.
- Different Kaiju appear from Day 1 through Day 5. You can challenge those same Kaiju from Day 6 through Day 10.
- You can attempt Defense Frontline up to 3 times per day.
- Your stage reached depends on the amount of damage you deal to the Kaiju. Reward amounts change based on your stage reached.

- A quest is cleared either after 8 rounds elapse or when the Kaiju is defeated.
- There is no defeat in Defense Frontline. You will receive rewards based on your stage reached.
- Rewards in Defense Frontline can be claimed up to 3 times per day. After clearing at least 1 quest in a day, you can skip your remaining attempts and earn rewards based on the highest stage reached that day.

## __REWARDS__
- Depending on the stage reached upon quest completion, you can earn rewards such as Dimensional Crystals, Crystal Shards, and ★5 unimaterials.
- The amount of certain rewards will vary even when clearing a quest at the same stage reached.
- For details on rewards, please refer to Defense Frontline > Rewards.
- The reward claim limit is refreshed at the daily reset.¹
¹ If you have remaining reward claims at 4:00 AM JST, they will be refreshed to reach a total of 3.

## __MOCK BATTLE__
- Mock Battles yield no rewards, but also do not consume challenge attempts.
- There is no daily limit on challenge attempts for Mock Battles.

## __STAGE EFFECTS__
- In Defense Frontline, each Kaiju features unique stage effects.
- Utilize the stage effects to give yourself an advantage in neutralizing Kaiju.

## __IMPORTANT__
- A challenge attempt will be consumed even if you retreat from battle.
- If you retreat, the quest will be cleared based on the stage reached for the damage dealt up to that point.
- If you clear a battle when the daily reset occurs during the session, it will consume a challenge attempt from before the reset and grant rewards.
- Data for a suspended battle started before the event ends will be kept for 12 hours from the start of the battle, regardless of whether the event concludes during the suspension.
- After 12 hours from battle start, the battle will be discarded and no rewards will be earned, even if the event is still ongoing.

- Challenge Mode has no daily limit on challenge attempts.
- In Challenge Mode, the Kaiju's remaining HP does not carry over between squads.
- In Challenge Mode, deployed characters cannot be added to another squad. However, the weapons they have equipped can still be equipped by characters in different squads.

article_item:
## __OVERVIEW__
Dimensional Swarm Disaster has come online as of <t:1788163200>.
Dimensional Swarm Disaster is a high-difficulty, seasonal battle event where you can gather Support Effects to power up your squad.
Equip desirable effects to gain an advantage in the battles and earn rewards upon clearing missions!

## __ELIGIBILITY__
Reach Spec-Ops Rank 4 or higher

## __EVENT DESCRIPTION__
- In Dimensional Swarm Disaster, gather Support Effects to power up your squad as you progress through the battle content.
- Gather Support Effects from Patrol Quests and proceed with Area Unlock quests to unlock higher Threat Levels.
- As you progress through the event, a trading function will unlock, allowing you to list and purchase items (such as Support Effects) with other players. Make use of this function to effectively collect desirable Support Effects.
- Gather desirable Support Effects from Patrol Quests of higher Threat Levels and take on the powerful enemy in Challenge Mode.

*Dimensional Swarm Disaster is a seasonal event. Except for the Shop item "Dimensional Medals" obtained from mission rewards, all items will be removed when the event ends and cannot be used in the next Dimensional Swarm Disaster.*

### __PATROL QUESTS__
- Patrol Quests consist of random combinations of Kaiju and Kaiju buffs.
- When clearing Patrol Quests, Support Effects and Support Effect Mod Items will randomly drop.
- Threat Levels will affect the difficulty of Patrol Quests. Kaiju in higher Threat Level quests are stronger; however, clearing these quests allows you to obtain better items.
- Patrol Quest Threat Levels will increase as you clear Area Unlock quests, up to a maximum of Threat Level 10.
- While taking on Kaiju, if you find it to be too challenging, you can change the Threat Level of Patrol Quests by using the Edit Lv button.

- You can skip up to 10 Patrol Quests per day. Once you have cleared a Patrol Quest, skipping quests of the same Threat Level becomes available.
- Patrol Quests are assigned random quest types. Depending on the type, there will be chances to get better item drops.
- After challenging 3 Patrol Quests on the map, you can rescan currently displayed quests.
- Clear the quests effectively and gather Support Effects to take on the Area Unlock quests.

*You cannot challenge a Patrol Quest you have already attempted. Challenge at least 3 quests to perform a rescan.*

### __AREA UNLOCK QUESTS__
- Area Unlock quests consist of fixed combinations of Kaiju and Kaiju buffs.
- There are 9 Threat Levels in total. Clearing higher Threat Levels in Area Unlock quests will unlock new Threat Levels for Patrol Quests.
- Random Support Effects and Support Effect Mod Items will drop only upon first clear.
- You will face powerful Kaiju while taking on Area Unlock quests. Be sure to fully prepare yourself by equipping useful Support Effects obtained via Patrol Quests.

### __CHALLENGE MODE__
- Take on Kaiju with massive HP and compete for a top ranking.
- Challenge Mode is unlocked after clearing Area Unlock: Threat Level 3.
- Extremely powerful Kaiju will appear, so unlock new Threat Levels through Area Unlock quests and Patrol Quests to gather desirable Support Effect combinations and compete for a top ranking.
## __SUPPORT EFFECTS__

### __SUPPORT EFFECTS__
- Support Effects are items obtainable from Patrol Quests and Area Unlock quests.
- Support Effects consist of 1 Main Effect and 4 Sub Effects. Equip them to power up your squad.
- Equip Support Effects before challenging a quest on the Dimensional Swarm Disaster: Setup screen.

*Owned Support Effects will be discarded once the event ends and cannot be carried over to the next season.*

### __TYPE/RARITY__
- There are three types of Support Effects: Attack, Defense, and Special. You can equip up to one Support Effect of each type.
- Support Effects come in 3 rarities: ★3 / ★4 / ★5. Higher rarity yields stronger effects.

### __MAIN EFFECTS__
- The Main Effect is fixed for each Support Effect.
- Higher Support Effect rarity offers higher effect values.

### __SUB EFFECTS__
- When obtaining a Support Effect, 4 Sub Effects are randomly assigned at random values.
- Sub Effects are assigned differently based on the type of Support Effect.
- Also, Sub Effects are numbered from 1 to 4, with different effects available for 1-2 and 3-4 separately.
- Higher Support Effect rarity increases the chance of getting better effects.

### __MODIFYING SUPPORT EFFECTS__
- Support Effect Mod Items allow you to redraw the Sub Effects of Support Effects.
- Sub Effects 1-4 can be redrawn depending on the type of Mod Item.
- Higher Mod Item rarity increases the chance of granting better values.
- Modifying is unlocked after clearing the quest Area Unlock: Threat Level 1.
*Owned Mod Items will be discarded once the event ends and cannot be carried over to the next season.*

## __TRADING__
- In Dimensional Swarm Disaster, the selling or purchasing of Support Effects and Support Effect Mod Items between players will be available using Tokens.

### __TOKENS__
- Tokens are exclusive items used to trade with other players.
- Obtained Support Effects can be exchanged for Tokens via Quick Sell.
- Quick Sell can be performed on the Support Effects/Items screen under the Owned tab.
- Tokens acquired via Quick Sell vary according to the type and rarity of Support Effects sold.

*A maximum of 999,999,999 Tokens can be held. Tokens exceeding the limit will be discarded when acquired.*
*Acquired Tokens will be discarded once the event ends and cannot be carried over to the next season.*
*When the max Support Effect limit is reached, you cannot deploy for or skip quests. Please sell the unneeded Support Effects.*
*Quick Sell is not available for Support Effect Mod Items.*

### __LISTING__
- You can set your own prices and list owned Support Effects/Support Effect Mod Items for other players.
- When other players purchase your listed items, you will earn Tokens equal to the set price.
- Quick Sell Support Effects to acquire Tokens.
- There is a limit to the number of Support Effects and Support Effect Mod Items you can list respectively.
- If you reach the limit, withdrawing listed items will allow you to list other items.
- You can list items after clearing the quest Area Unlock: Threat Level 3.

### __PURCHASING__
- Support Effects and Mod Items listed by other players can be purchased using acquired Tokens.
- Purchase Support Effects at the price set by other players, provided you have enough Tokens.
- When purchasing Mod Items, specify your desired price per unit and purchase quantity to buy items at the quantity that meets your criteria.
- You can purchase items after clearing the quest Area Unlock: Threat Level 3.
## __REWARDS__

### __MISSION REWARDS__
- There are missions in Dimensional Swarm Disaster.
- Obtain Dimensional Medals from the missions.
- You can exchange Dimensional Medals for various items in the Shop.
- Shop items that are not labelled with "Days left:" remain exchangeable using Dimensional Medals obtained from the next season of Dimensional Swarm Disaster.
- Owned Dimensional Medals will be carried over even after the event ends.

### __CHALLENGE MODE REWARDS__
- Challenge Mode features damage-based ranking. You can earn rewards according to your rank.
- The total damage dealt in a battle serves as your score. Rankings will be determined based on the highest scores during the period.
- You can check your score and rank from Challenge Mode > Ranking.¹
- Ranking rewards will be distributed via Mail after the tallying period following the event's conclusion.²

- For details on rewards, please refer to Challenge Mode > Ranking > Rewards.

¹ The Top 100 info on the Ranking screen is updated every 5 minutes. Depending on the timing of the update, your score may differ from the score displayed in the rankings.
² The mail (including any attached items) will be deleted 90 days after you receive it. Please make sure to open the mail and claim the items before the deadline.

## __EVENT PROGRESS RESET__
- Obtained Support Effects, Support Effect Mod Items, Tokens and all quest progress will be reset once the event ends. They will not be carried over to the next season.
- Acquired Dimensional Medals will be retained and the number owned will not be reset.

## __IMPORTANT__
- Once the claim period ends, Mission rewards will no longer be available (and will not be sent to your Mail). Please remember to claim them within the event period.

## __OVERVIEW__
Thank you for playing KAIJU NO. 8 THE GAME.
To protect your game data, we ask that you link your account.

## __ACCOUNT LINKING__
By linking your account, you can easily restore and transfer your game data even if you accidentally delete the app.
Additionally, if your current device malfunctions or if you wish to change devices, you can transfer your player data to the new device.

## __HOW TO LINK YOUR ACCOUNT__
You can link your account to your Apple Account or Google Account.
Steps to Link Account:
1. Select the global menu from the top right of the Home screen.
2. From the Menu (≡) on the top left of the screen, select Account Linking.
*Account Linking is not possible via "Data Transfer" on the title screen.*

3. On the Confirm Link screen, you can choose to "Sign in with Apple" or "Sign in with Google."
4. Sign in with your selected account.

https://asset.kj8-thegame.com/info/production/content/1000030/24c168d8edfd5660c027eb7977e576f9.png?Expires=1790798438&Signature=fJGOFghi9B9o0j7Y6ftk5sXkEGy7wwAdQmab0xYQnbRjH-M9cXadfUymNa8WWNpU6bntPXFZFO9kaJ5dTttXFibD0XaTyzaRwiZGDc3uxWtNzFEkkZfRpI7AQpzUKYlKvXuNdw6rjFYAEnMmT~-LQiz~ofT7UKFb1ENKERHF95N8~PIl0WHG8y-9sW1MlO5Vi9hBjYpDsMDd6vj8I9-NXIrohh9m9mbNM8yk21eWqe6OrMO-7XaJC4d9EZ8NHQC72Oz1uwyCh2NU0gCoVwcC5-mZbU0M8o28b5W-nYAbmUZxax7MF63EMZeM4258sRvX5USGwr~VHyfK0ZOcD3NFNw__&Key-Pair-Id=K22LOBLWI3HWJQ

After signing in, the message "Account linking complete" will appear upon successful linking.
*Please keep your linked account information secure and avoid sharing it with others.*
*After account linking is complete, a confirmation email will be automatically sent to the email address associated with the linked account.*

## __FAQ: REGARDING ACCOUNT LINKING__
Q1: How do I restore my data or transfer my account?
A1: Access Title Menu (≡) on the title screen, select Data Transfer and follow the on-screen instructions.

Q2: After transferring account, will I be able to pick up my game progress from when I linked my account?
A2: You can proceed with the game from when you were last online. For example, if you link your account when a mission is ongoing and transfer your account after clearing the mission, the game will proceed from the time when the mission is cleared.

Q3: After transferring my account to a different device, can I still play on the original device?
A3: Yes, you can play on both devices. However, you cannot log in to the same account on both devices simultaneously. If a new login is detected on a device, you will be returned to the title screen on the previous device.

Q4: Will my linked account be unlinked if I delete my player data?
A4: No, deleting your player data will not unlink your account. To unlink an account, go to Menu (≡) > Account Linking.

Q5: I wish to change my linked account.
A5: To do so, first unlink your current account via Menu (≡) > Account Linking. You will then be able to link a new account.
